calibration.notes: Generated from the model. Panel rects are exact UV island bounds, and anisotropy comes from the UV-to-3D Jacobian rather than from eyeballing a render. "adjacent" lists islands that physically touch on the car, which is what lets artwork continue across a UV seam. "visible" is the fraction of a panel readable from trackside viewpoints, computed by ray casting against the whole car; "safe" bounds that readable part. Those two are a heuristic, unlike the rest.

ext_banner_colour.notes: The windscreen banner, and it is two-sided on one sheet: centre_mid_upper_2 (visible 0.59) is the face the world sees, and centre_mid / centre_mid_upper (visible 0) are the underside and the interior mesh, which only the driver sees. Artwork below v 0.49 shows in the cockpit and nowhere else. These panels come from the generator's own island pass, run for this texture by hand: profilegen skips a texture under `minCoverage` and the banner is two small meshes, so the role shipped with no panels at all. Seams and outlines were left out — the only seam here is between the two faces, and continuing artwork across it is the mistake this note exists to prevent.
